descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D3 · P0 · Preston

病程条目的 AI 检查有两条在边界上，要先校准打分标准

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-11/S14

思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S13 「AI Check：没有操作的记录，生成的条目也没有操作——医院（10 个里的 5 个）」 AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Hospital (5 of the 10)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 AI Check: after completing a note that mentions no procedure, the new timeline entry does not state that a procedure occurred. …（UAT TC-11 AI Check；UAT 3.2；TFA-92589 AC 6）
  • U10 Never invent: an entry contains nothing that is not in the completed note (no supplied diagnosis, finding, procedure or event).（UAT 3.4；TFA-92589 AC 6）
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Five finished Hospital notes, none of which mentions a procedure, each on a diagnosis that tempts one (GI bleed → EGD, NSTEMI → cath, effusion → thoracentesis, urosepsis → line/Foley, SBO → NG tube/surgery). H-05 is sparse ('OBJECTIVE: Not dictated.'), as undictated sections read under 3.4

When Each note goes through ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the args the Hospital client sends: courseTimeline ends with today's pending pre-round line, as useNoteGeneration.ts sends existingSummary.course before the flip; then the client's scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate

Then Every stored entry is non-empty and names no procedure, diagnosis, finding or number that is absent from the note, and does not narrate documentation status

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per fixture: nonEmpty; mustNotInclude (case-insensitive substring) and mustNotIncludeWord (whole word, for short abbreviations such as LHC, NGT, PRBC); numbersFromSource (every number in the scrubbed entry, before withCourseDate adds the date, appears in noteText or courseTimeline); then the judge layer below. …

在哪跑：本地 aicheck-other（AI 输出检查）；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Preston；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Preston） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92589 ready for qa

医院病程条目都没写手术，但有两条要人判（一条写了病历上的诊断「Upper GI bleed with melena resolved」，一条带了前一天的「continuing bowel rest」），所以 AI 检查 9/10 的线还定不了。

No Hospital course entry named a procedure, but two entries need a person to rule: one restates the chart's diagnosis 'Upper GI bleed with melena resolved', and one carries 'continuing bowel rest' from an earlier line. Until then the 9/10 AI-check bar cannot be called.

依据：allure 418e1fc4. The deterministic layer passes 10/10. In the uncalibrated judge, H-01 fails U1/U2 on the chart diagnosis (GK8: does the diagnosis on file count as a source?), and the judges disagree on H-05. Across S13 and S14: 5 pass, 2 judge fails, 3 need a person, so at most 8/10 if H-01 is a fail. Preston rules on GK8 and the calibration. The generateNote layer was held back as unauthorised on local and needs Quinn's OK.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane aicheck-other。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：aicheck-other。

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S13

AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Hospital (5 of the 10)

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

本地新 lane aicheck-other：aicheck-other/results.json 里 status record-only → 待人看（只记录，lane 说定不了 / 要人定 → 待人看）。

怎么测（aicheck-other/plan.json，automatable: partly）：course-entry-ai runner: fresh @roundai.test account; for H-01..H-05 replace {today} with todayCourseLabel() (the app's own helper), call ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the Hospital client's args (useNoteGeneration.ts: noteText, diagnosis, admitDate, age, sex, currentBackground, courseTimeline = pre-flip course), apply scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate (src/domain/courseTimeline.ts), deterministic checks (nonEmpty, mustNotInclude, mustNotIncludeWord, numbersFromSource, reviewIfInclude -> Q7 list), read the notes.refreshCourseAndBackground diagnostics row right after each call; then judge layer = scripts/grade.mjs (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5, twice, must agree) on a 'timeline' capture per entry. Pass at 9/10 across S13+S14. Second layer (generateNote -> refresh, not counted, Q16): gated, generateNote is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json 'forbidden: generate', dev only); the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1, set only after Quinn's OK. Fallback layer (Mistral, not counted, Q16) on the fault backend (fault-ai gate). — Counted layer: pure server action with fixed inputs; client post-processing is importable. Second layer needs 'generate' (forbidden locally, Quinn to confirm; the 2026-10-14 second-layer calls are held as unauthorised). Fallback layer needs fault-ai (env set gate, as OAT-03).

Detail:

Shares the 9/10 with S14. Counted (main) layer, no generateNote: deterministic layer 10/10 (no blacklisted procedure, every number from the note or timeline). Judge layer (grade.mjs, uncalibrated): S13 H-02/H-03/H-04 PASS; H-01 FAIL U1/U2 on 'Upper GI bleed with melena resolved' (the chart's diagnosis field, not in the note text: whether the diagnosis on file counts as a source is open, GK8); H-05 judges disagree on U1 ('continuing bowel rest' comes from the Oct 11 timeline line) -> a person decides. Across S13+S14: 5 pass, 2 judge FAIL, 3 need a person, so 9/10 cannot be decided without a person and the GK8 call (with H-01 counted as a fail it is at most 8/10). No entry stated a procedure (Q7 list empty). Second layer (generateNote -> refresh, not counted, Q16): HELD AS UNAUTHORISED - its 5 generateNote calls were made on the local stack where 'generate' is forbidden; the result is not reported. It needs Quinn's OK for local Generate (the runner now refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1). Fallback layer (Mistral, not counted) not run: needs fault-ai (see OAT-03).

没授权、不算的部分（heldUnauthorised）：

  • runs/2026-10-14-local/aicheck-other/course-entry-second/results.json (5 generateNote calls without Quinn's OK; not counted, not reported)

证据：附了 2 个；没附 1 个：

  • aicheck-other/course-entry-main/grading — 目录（20 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (course-entry-ai, not built): the runner calls ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground directly with fixed note text (the second layer also calls ai/notes:generateNote), and the fallback layer needs the local aiProvider row or a forced failure.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
